task.title: Make retry and health independent of compatibility storage root

raw.question: Route every scoped retry path from the persisted allowlist
raw.chosen: Route every scoped retry path from the persisted allowlist
raw.reasoning: Dead-letter storage placement is a compatibility detail and cannot safely determine the Syncer for a comma-joined multi-root operation.
